headline: Sales Specialist
workPreference: Manufacturing & Production, Warehouse & Fulfillment, Customer Service & Events, Office & Professional
summary: Service- and sales-oriented professional with experience coordinating teams, training new staff, and managing customer relationships across retail, food service, and delivery coordination roles. Skilled at managing multiple priorities, resolving issues quickly, and maintaining strong working relationships with clients and coworkers. Comfortable working independently or as part of a team, with a strong focus on continuous learning and service quality.
